fields.name: title
fields.description: task label shown on the bar

fields.name: start
fields.description: task start timestamp the bar is placed from

fields.name: end
fields.description: task end timestamp the bar is placed to; when absent, duration days are used

fields.name: status
fields.description: task lifecycle status, drives bar colour

fields.name: group
fields.description: group/section the task renders under a header row for

events.name: TaskLoaded
events.description: Indicates that schedule tasks have been successfully retrieved.

events.name: TaskLoadFailed
events.description: Indicates a failure to load schedule tasks.
Emitted when a gantt bar is clicked; { id } carries the clicked task row's id.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Day width
overridableConfigKeys.description: Pixels per day on the time axis.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Duration field
overridableConfigKeys.description: Row column holding the task length in days, used when the row has no end value. Empty = bars always read endField.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: duration column, length field, days field

overridableConfigKeys.label: End field
overridableConfigKeys.description: Row column holding the end timestamp each bar is placed to. When a row has no end, durationField (days) is used instead.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: end column, due field, finish field

overridableConfigKeys.label: Group field
overridableConfigKeys.description: Row column rows are grouped under header rows by (e.g. team, project). Empty (default) = flat list, no group headers.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: group column, swimlane field, section field

overridableConfigKeys.label: Which relation fields to hydrate?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Entity relation field names to hydrate on fetch, so field mappings can use dot-paths like assignee.name. Empty = no hydration, the default.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: relation hydration, populate relations, joined fields

overridableConfigKeys.label: Label field
overridableConfigKeys.description: Row column holding the bar label. Rebound hosts point this at their own column (e.g. name, summary).
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: title field, label column, name field

overridableConfigKeys.label: Dependency links
overridableConfigKeys.description: Dependency arrows between task ids ({ from, to }); the host derives them from its own relation field and passes them here.

overridableConfigKeys.label: On bar click
overridableConfigKeys.description: Event emitted when a bar is clicked: UI:{onBarClick} with { id } carrying the clicked row's id. Empty means bars are not clickable.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: bar click, task click, select task, open task

overridableConfigKeys.label: Range end
overridableConfigKeys.description: Last visible day (ISO date). Empty (default) = 2 days after the latest task end.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: window end, axis end, to date

overridableConfigKeys.label: Range start
overridableConfigKeys.description: First visible day (ISO date). Empty (default) = 2 days before the earliest task.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: window start, axis start, from date

overridableConfigKeys.label: Show today marker
overridableConfigKeys.description: Paint the today marker line when today falls inside the visible range.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Start field
overridableConfigKeys.description: Row column holding the start timestamp each bar is placed from (e.g. startTime, startsAt, beginsAt).
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: start column, from field, begin field

overridableConfigKeys.label: Status field
overridableConfigKeys.description: Row column holding the status value that drives bar colour.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: status column, state field, stage field

overridableConfigKeys.label: Title
overridableConfigKeys.description: Header text shown above the gantt chart.
